subject: planner, CTE, view: Fix default inline CTE which contains orderby/limit/distinct and inside of view (#56609)
summary: Updates CTE inlining decisions in the planner: (1) tracks additional operators (ORDER BY / LIMIT / DISTINCT, plus existing agg/window) as “recursive-forbidden” so CTEs containing them won’t be inlined when referenced from a recursive CTE’s recursive part, and (2) avoids default inlining when CTE consumer count is unavailable (notably consumerCount==0 in views), requiring a hint/var to force inlining. This prevents inlining from pushing forbidden constructs into recursive query blocks and fixes view-embedded CTE cases where consumer counts were not updated.
